claims.correspondence: none: the retained kernel extraction predates SignedSelf

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.sitesAt_iff
theorems.role: the Bool self-site check holds exactly when every marked site invokes the owner at the owner witness
theorems.statement: @NobleM2.SignedSelf.sitesAt_iff : ∀ {sc : NobleM2.SignedSelf.SignedCandidate} {owner : Nat} {ownerInst : NobleM2.Inst}, NobleM2.SignedSelf.sitesAt sc owner ownerInst = true ↔ ∀ (site : Nat), site ∈ sc.selfSites → sc.cand.nodes[site]? = some (NobleM2.Node.invocation owner ownerInst)

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned_soundness
theorems.role: K-CHECK-02 soundness: signed acceptance implies the reference checker's well-formedness and SignedDerives: the body derives the owner's declared signature at the owner witness, with every self site at that witness
theorems.statement: @NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned_soundness : ∀ {env : NobleM2.Env} {request : NobleM2.Request} {sc : NobleM2.SignedSelf.SignedCandidate} {owner : Nat} {ownerInst : NobleM2.Inst} {checked : NobleM2.Checked}, NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned env request sc owner ownerInst = NobleM2.Outcome.accepted checked → NobleM2.WellFormed request sc.cand checked ∧ NobleM2.SignedSelf.SignedDerives env request sc owner ownerInst checked.interface.effects

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned_refuses_polymorphic_recursion
theorems.role: K-CHECK-02: a self site at any witness other than the owner witness is refused
theorems.statement: @NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned_refuses_polymorphic_recursion : ∀ {env : NobleM2.Env} {request : NobleM2.Request} {sc : NobleM2.SignedSelf.SignedCandidate} {owner : Nat} {ownerInst inst : NobleM2.Inst} {site : Nat}, site ∈ sc.selfSites → sc.cand.nodes[site]? = some (NobleM2.Node.invocation owner inst) → inst ≠ ownerInst → ∀ (checked : NobleM2.Checked), NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned env request sc owner ownerInst ≠ NobleM2.Outcome.accepted checked

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned_refuses_a_foreign_self_site
theorems.role: K-CHECK-02: a self site invoking another definition (mutual recursion) is refused
theorems.statement: @NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned_refuses_a_foreign_self_site : ∀ {env : NobleM2.Env} {request : NobleM2.Request} {sc : NobleM2.SignedSelf.SignedCandidate} {owner other : Nat} {ownerInst inst : NobleM2.Inst} {site : Nat}, site ∈ sc.selfSites → sc.cand.nodes[site]? = some (NobleM2.Node.invocation other inst) → other ≠ owner → ∀ (checked : NobleM2.Checked), NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned env request sc owner ownerInst ≠ NobleM2.Outcome.accepted checked

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned_requires_a_named_owner
theorems.role: K-CHECK-02: an owner that is not a named definition, so has no declared signature, is refused
theorems.statement: @NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned_requires_a_named_owner : ∀ {env : NobleM2.Env} {request : NobleM2.Request} {sc : NobleM2.SignedSelf.SignedCandidate} {owner : Nat} {ownerInst : NobleM2.Inst}, env.kind owner ≠ some NobleM2.Behavior.named → ∀ (checked : NobleM2.Checked), NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned env request sc owner ownerInst ≠ NobleM2.Outcome.accepted checked

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.acceptsWith_spec
theorems.role: fixture classifier: an acceptsWith verdict is an acceptance with that interface
theorems.statement: @NobleM2.SignedSelf.acceptsWith_spec : ∀ {outcome : NobleM2.Outcome} {stackIn stackOut : NobleM2.TyList} {effects : NobleM2.EffSet}, NobleM2.SignedSelf.acceptsWith outcome stackIn stackOut effects = true → ∃ checked, outcome = NobleM2.Outcome.accepted checked ∧ checked.interface.stackIn = stackIn ∧ checked.interface.stackOut = stackOut ∧ checked.interface.effects = effects

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.refusesNodeForm_spec
theorems.role: fixture classifier: a refusesNodeForm verdict is the unsupported nodeForm refusal
theorems.statement: @NobleM2.SignedSelf.refusesNodeForm_spec : ∀ {outcome : NobleM2.Outcome}, NobleM2.SignedSelf.refusesNodeForm outcome = true → outcome = NobleM2.Outcome.unsupported NobleM2.UnsupportedKind.nodeForm

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.forever_accepted
theorems.role: fixture: the signed check accepts def forever [ forever ] at its declared [] -- [] ! pure
theorems.statement: NobleM2.SignedSelf.forever_accepted : NobleM2.SignedSelf.acceptsWith (NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerEnv NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyRequest NobleM2.SignedSelf.forever NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerIndex NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyWitness) NobleM2.TyList.nil NobleM2.TyList.nil NobleM2.EffSet.empty = true

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.forever_signed_derives
theorems.role: fixture: forever satisfies SignedDerives, by soundness from its acceptance
theorems.statement: NobleM2.SignedSelf.forever_signed_derives : NobleM2.SignedSelf.SignedDerives NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerEnv NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyRequest NobleM2.SignedSelf.forever NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerIndex NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyWitness NobleM2.EffSet.empty

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.polymorphic_ordinary_check_accepts
theorems.role: fixture: the ordinary reference checker types a self call that instantiates the signature differently
theorems.statement: NobleM2.SignedSelf.polymorphic_ordinary_check_accepts : NobleM2.SignedSelf.acceptsWith (NobleM2.check NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerEnv NobleM2.SignedSelf.intRequest NobleM2.SignedSelf.polymorphic.cand) (NobleM2.TyList.cons NobleM2.Ty.i64 NobleM2.TyList.nil) (NobleM2.TyList.cons NobleM2.Ty.i64 NobleM2.TyList.nil) NobleM2.EffSet.empty = true

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.polymorphic_signed_refused
theorems.role: fixture: the signed check refuses that polymorphic self call (kernel-decided)
theorems.statement: NobleM2.SignedSelf.polymorphic_signed_refused : NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerEnv NobleM2.SignedSelf.intRequest NobleM2.SignedSelf.polymorphic NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerIndex NobleM2.SignedSelf.intWitness = NobleM2.Outcome.unsupported NobleM2.UnsupportedKind.nodeForm

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.monomorphic_accepted
theorems.role: fixture: the same body with its self site at the owner witness is accepted
theorems.statement: NobleM2.SignedSelf.monomorphic_accepted : NobleM2.SignedSelf.acceptsWith (NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerEnv NobleM2.SignedSelf.intRequest NobleM2.SignedSelf.monomorphic NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerIndex NobleM2.SignedSelf.intWitness) (NobleM2.TyList.cons NobleM2.Ty.i64 NobleM2.TyList.nil) (NobleM2.TyList.cons NobleM2.Ty.i64 NobleM2.TyList.nil) NobleM2.EffSet.empty = true

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.unsigned_owner_refused
theorems.role: fixture: a bootstrap word cannot own a self call (kernel-decided)
theorems.statement: NobleM2.SignedSelf.unsigned_owner_refused : NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned NobleM2.SignedSelf.ownerEnv NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyRequest { cand := { format := 0, revision := 0, nodes := [NobleM2.Node.invocation 0 NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyWitness], body := [0] }, selfSites := [0] } 0 NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyWitness = NobleM2.Outcome.unsupported NobleM2.UnsupportedKind.nodeForm

theorems.name: NobleM2.SignedSelf.foreign_self_site_refused
theorems.role: fixture: a self site invoking a different named definition is refused (kernel-decided)
theorems.statement: NobleM2.SignedSelf.foreign_self_site_refused : NobleM2.SignedSelf.checkSigned NobleM2.SignedSelf.twoOwnerEnv NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyRequest NobleM2.SignedSelf.forever 24 NobleM2.SignedSelf.emptyWitness = NobleM2.Outcome.unsupported NobleM2.UnsupportedKind.nodeForm

scope: The signed check over the M2 reference model: a self site is the owner invocation the kernel types it as, marked by index.
checkSigned_soundness: acceptance implies SignedDerives (the body derives the owner's declared signature at the owner witness, every self site at that witness).
Module ownership, the public checker's refusal of SignedSelf nodes and self edges through ordinary invocations are outside the model.
